verdict.rationale: HeyGen is an automatable video platform with an API, MCP, batch and webhook support, and n8n/Make/Zapier integrations, so asking about versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question. The pack documents no versioning, change review or rollback for automations or workflows. Revising video scenes and reviewing storyboards apply to video content, not automations, and enterprise audit logs are only an adjacent control, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
